Marissa,

Thanks for the context and the two options. Quick guidance:

- AE-level approvals: up to 15% discount and credits up to $25k for pilot engagements are typically OK to approve from a sales ops perspective for strategic pilots (no formal exec sign-off required).
- Anything above 15% or credits above $25k should be escalated to revenue ops / sales leadership (Vivek) with a short business case.

Given the customer's stated ARR intent ($200k-$300k), I recommend proposing Option A (15% + $25k credit) as the default pilot offer. In parallel, offer Option B as a quoted upgrade path contingent on a 12-month reserved commit of $250k - and include a pricing table that shows unit economics post-commit. That gives the customer a clear path and protects our economics.

I've added the HubSpot link for the deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2026-0078

If Vivek approves anything richer (20%+/larger credit) please include a short note on why (strategic value, reference, and expected expansion timeline).
